response: {"thought": "回購客戶是客戶層級指標，需依 2025 年台北時間的有效訂單（status 1,2,3）計算，地區取自客戶資料。先確認南部對應的地區代碼，並直接計算南部回購客戶數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT DISTINCT region_code FROM customers ORDER BY region_code", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers_south FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE cu.region_code = 'TW-S' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y', datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')) = '2025' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)"]}}
